This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.90/2024 registered at Police Station Shahpura District Rewa (M.P.) for the offence under Section 34(2) of the M.P. Excise Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that this is only one case registered against the applicant of Excise Act.

There is no previous conviction of applicant under Section 34(1)
of the Excise Act.
One case is registered against the applicant in the year 2010 for offence under Section 376 of the IPC.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail.
4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
